# Enforces the tenant_id/external_reference uniqueness invariant at the
# database boundary.
#
# Boundary design:
#   - The unique index is the authoritative, race-safe guarantee: two
#     concurrent inserts with the same pair cannot both commit, no
#     matter which process or write path races.
#   - The model's uniqueness validation stays for friendly errors in
#     the common case; the index is what holds the invariant under
#     concurrency. A concurrent duplicate that loses the race surfaces
#     as ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique at the call boundary, where it
#     is reported as a validation-style error instead of a crash.
#   - The index is built concurrently so the constraint can be added to
#     a populated orders table without blocking writes, and
#     disable_ddl_transaction! is required because a concurrent build
#     cannot run inside a transaction block.
#   - Existing rows are audited for duplicates before this migration
#     deploys; a violating pair must be resolved first, or the index
#     build itself fails.
class AddOrderReferenceConstraint < ActiveRecord::Migration[8.1]
  disable_ddl_transaction!

  def change
    add_index :orders, [:tenant_id, :external_reference], unique: true, algorithm: :concurrently
  end
end
